Title: Heritage Daily Health Toned Milk
Description: Healthy and nutritious, Heritage Toned Milk (Polypack) is a delicious drink that can be relished anytime of the day. Enriched with nutrients, it can be used to make tea and coffee and in the preparation of sweets, curd, buttermilk, etc.
Ingredients: Milk solids (Toned Milk), Vitamin A (Palmitate) & Vitamin D (Ergocalciferol)
